name: @repoise/vscode
description: Inspect Repoise setup, freshness and coverage, run indexing, supervise an extension-owned watch and set up the Repoise stdio MCP server. A thin operations UI over the installed Repoise CLI (docs/vscode.md).

repoise.cliPath.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the `repoise` binary (highest discovery precedence). Leave empty to prefer a repository-local package install, then PATH.

repoise.mcp.refresh.markdownDescription: Expose the opt-in `refresh_project_knowledge` tool in the extension-provided MCP server definition. Read-only stays the default.

repoise.watch.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start an extension-owned watch for the selected root when the status panel opens. Restarts are bounded with backoff.

scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-fixtures.cjs && node --test "out/test/*.test.js"
